description: This file defines a 'Calendar' class with methods for constructing calendar views (day, week, month, year), navigating dates, and adding activities/appointments. It also includes related helper classes like 'Layout' and functions for calendar-related computations.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Main class for managing and rendering calendar views, handling activities, and date navigation.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Helper class representing a calendar layout segment (hour, day, month) with start and end times.

methods.name: Calendar
methods.description: Constructor initializing the calendar view, date, and layout.

methods.name: getCalendarView
methods.description: Returns the label for a given calendar view type.

methods.name: constructLayout
methods.description: Builds the calendar layout based on the current view (day, week, month, year).

methods.name: get_datechange_info
methods.description: Calculates the new date string after moving forward or backward in time according to the view.

methods.name: add_Activities
methods.description: Reads and adds appointments/activities to the calendar slices based on user preferences and current view.

calls: vtiger CRM classes/methods for date and time handling
